name: Комбінація (3)
description:
A combination involves using multiple tactical concepts at the same time. Sometimes you also sacrifice material temporarily, in order to win it back with interest.

What do you have to do?

Win material by means of a combination.

examples.text: White can force a favorable exchange with 1.Rxd7! Two pieces are considerably stronger than a rook.
The knight on d4 is covered, but white has a trick! After the exchange, white has a winning discovered check.

examples.pgn: 1. b4 {[%csl Gb4,Rc5][%cal Gb4c5]} Nca4 2. c5 {[%csl Gb4,Rb6,Gc5,Rd6][%cal Gb4c5,Gc5b6,Gc5d6]} Nxc5 3. bxc5 {[%csl Gc5]} *

texts: Suddenly, Black can no longer cover all pieces.
